outcome: incidence of hypotension following spinal anaesthesia
cohort: 120 healthy parturients undergoing elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia were divided into two groups based on baseline PI (PI>3.5 and PI<3.5).
finding: A higher baseline perfusion index (>3.5) is significantly correlated with an increased incidence of hypotension (71% vs 41%) following spinal anaesthesia in parturients undergoing caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study's primary finding directly relates to mode of birth, indicating that a higher baseline perfusion index predicts hypotension during spinal anaesthesia for caesarean section.
